products.title: Power Denim 5-Pocket Jeans
products.description: Unmatched durability meets unmatched comfort in the Power Denim 5-Pocket Jeans. Crafted from ultra-tough Dyneema® fibers and US cotton, they're lightweight yet incredibly tear-resistant.
